doubts: The text does not say which direction the circuit is walked beyond 'clockwise or anti-clockwise'; the description runs Young confluence, Young Hut, Siberia Hut, Kerin Forks, out to Makarora. How the walker returns from Makarora to the start is not stated, so the loop closes at the start by inference. W2's via order is my inference of going round the same way from the Wilkin confluence. The page says to cross the Wilkin River to reach Kerin Forks Hut but does not place that crossing on the circuit, so no Wilkin ford is recorded. The first Makarora crossing is implied by 'Once across the Makarora'. Via refs for Gillespie Pass and the Wilkin River are inferred from the track's name and route. Main way start and end set to Makarora, as the page's section headings run ("Makarora to Young Hut", "Siberia Hut to Makarora"); the Young/Makarora confluence it begins from has no place on the map.
